objective: Compose the ACC-6 semantic-plane journey (M05 ontology, M03 authority, M01 daemon effect boundary) into one runnable check over the existing unit done-bars, on one basis, against each done-bar's own real daemon with fixtures disabled.
falsifiable_claim: npm run check:acceptance-semantic-plane runs every ACC-6 positive clause's done-bar and the minutes-scale negative-clause battery sequentially in one process, re-reads the git basis after every clause, clears every shared-daemon/replay redirection variable for every child, and reports PASS only when every clause (including every negative clause's executed mutation battery) is green; without `-- --mutation-batteries` it reports PARTIAL at best, never PASS.
adversarial_or_fault_proof: npm run mutate:acceptance-semantic-plane plants a red clause and asserts the composed verdict fails; the run of 2026-09-08 itself went red on two real findings (check:env-lease-authority R1_DERIVED_CLOSED_WORLD and check:ontology-admission-census 23/27) that the per-unit accounting had been citing as real without re-running.
remaining_nonclaims: The composed journey is RED on e8bc1d809: clause 5 (check:env-lease-authority 18/19, R1_DERIVED_CLOSED_WORLD) and negative clause N2 (check:ontology-admission-census 23/27 and its mutation drill) fail; the six multi-hour M05 batteries were not executed on this basis. ACC-6 is therefore not proven; the runner is the instrument, not the proof.
The runner certifies nothing a done-bar does not itself assert; clause coverage is the done-bars' coverage.
